decisions.reason: As in verses 17 and 24, the soul (nefesh) is the whole person.

decisions.choice: to act; comes to him for help
decisions.reason: Readable says what the waiting is for and what seeking him means (m2, m3).

records.literal_gloss: Good [it is] that [one] waits and in silence for [the] salvation of Yahweh.

en.L: [It is] good that one wait, and in silence, \q for the salvation of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: It is good to wait in silence \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s salvation.
en.R: It is good to wait quietly \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to save us.

pt.L: [É] bom que se espere, e em silêncio, \q pela salvação {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: É bom esperar em silêncio \q pela salvação que vem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: É bom esperar com calma \q que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} venha nos salvar.

fr.L: [Il est] bon qu’on attende, et en silence, \q le salut {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il est bon d’attendre en silence \q le salut {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il est bon d’attendre calmement \q que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous sauve.

es.L: Bueno [es] esperar, y en silencio, \q la salvación {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Es bueno esperar en silencio \q la salvación {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Es bueno esperar con calma \q a que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos salve.

vi.L: [Thật] tốt khi người ta chờ đợi, và trong im lặng, \q sự cứu rỗi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Thật tốt khi lặng lẽ chờ đợi \q sự cứu rỗi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Thật tốt khi yên lặng chờ đợi \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến cứu chúng ta.

sw.L: [Ni] vema mtu angoje, naye kimya, \q wokovu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ni vizuri kungoja kimya \q wokovu unaotoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ni vizuri kungoja kwa utulivu \q mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atuokoe.

ko.L: 기다리는 것, 잠잠히 [기다리는 것이] 좋다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 구원을.
ko.B: 잠잠히 기다리는 것이 좋다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 구원해 주실 때까지.
ko.R: 조용히 기다리는 것이 좋다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 구해 주실 때까지.

decisions.choice: wait, and in silence: waiting quietly
decisions.reason: The two words are joined by 'and': one waits, and does it in silence, without complaining. The silence returns in verse 28.

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue that comes from the LORD
decisions.reason: The word (teshu'ah) means deliverance or rescue, here the LORD's rescue of his people from their distress (Psalm 37:39).

decisions.choice: for the LORD to save us
decisions.reason: Readable turns the noun into a verb and names those he saves; the poem moves toward 'we' in verses 40-47.

records.literal_gloss: Good [it is] for a man that he bears a yoke in his youth.

en.L: [It is] good for a man that he carry a yoke \q in his youth.
en.B: A man does well to take up a yoke \q while he is still young.
en.R: It is good for a man to learn to carry hard loads \q while he is still young.

pt.L: [É] bom para um homem que ele carregue um jugo \q na sua juventude.
pt.B: Faz bem ao homem tomar um jugo sobre si \q enquanto ainda é jovem.
pt.R: É bom que o homem aprenda a carregar cargas pesadas \q enquanto ainda é jovem.

fr.L: [Il est] bon pour l’homme qu’il porte un joug \q dans sa jeunesse.
fr.B: Il est bon pour un homme de prendre sur lui un joug \q pendant qu’il est encore jeune.
fr.R: Il est bon pour un homme d’apprendre à porter de lourdes charges \q pendant qu’il est encore jeune.

es.L: Bueno [es] para el hombre llevar el yugo \q en su juventud.
es.B: Le hace bien al hombre cargar con un yugo \q mientras todavía es joven.
es.R: Es bueno que un hombre aprenda a llevar cargas pesadas \q mientras todavía es joven.

vi.L: [Thật] tốt cho một người khi mang ách \q trong tuổi trẻ mình.
vi.B: Thật tốt cho một người khi gánh ách \q lúc còn trẻ.
vi.R: Thật tốt cho một người khi học mang gánh nặng \q lúc còn trẻ.

sw.L: [Ni] vema kwa mtu kwamba abebe nira \q katika ujana wake.
sw.B: Mtu hufanya vema kujitwika nira \q angali bado kijana.
sw.R: Ni vizuri mtu ajifunze kubeba mizigo mizito \q angali bado kijana.

ko.L: 사람이 멍에를 메는 것이 그에게 좋다, \q 그의 젊은 시절에.
ko.B: 사람은 멍에를 메는 것이 좋다, \q 아직 젊을 때에.
ko.R: 사람은 무거운 짐을 지는 법을 배우는 것이 좋다, \q 아직 젊을 때에.

decisions.choice: a yoke: a burden laid on someone, here hardship and discipline
decisions.reason: A yoke was the wooden bar laid on the neck of oxen to pull a load. It stands for a burden or for submission to someone (Jeremiah 27:8; Lamentations 1:14). Learning to bear it while young prepares a person for the trials of life.

decisions.choice: a man: the same word as 'the man' of verse 1
decisions.reason: The word (geber) is the one the speaker used for himself in verse 1. The wisdom of verses 27-30 holds for anyone, but it is put in terms of 'a man', so that he is speaking of himself as well.

decisions.choice: a man
decisions.reason: All levels keep 'man' so that the link with verse 1 is heard; the lesson itself is for anyone (m2).

decisions.choice: to learn to carry hard loads
decisions.reason: Readable says what the yoke stands for (m1).

source.text: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Let him sit alone and be silent, for he has laid [it] on him.

en.L: Let him sit alone and be silent, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has laid [it] on him.
en.B: Let him sit by himself and keep silent \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has laid it on him.
en.R: When God puts that load on him, \q he should sit alone and keep quiet.

pt.L: Que ele se sente sozinho e fique calado, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [o] pôs sobre ele.
pt.B: Que ele se sente à parte e fique em silêncio \q quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o puser sobre ele.
pt.R: Quando Deus puser essa carga sobre ele, \q ele deve se sentar sozinho e ficar quieto.

fr.L: Qu’il s’asseye seul et se taise, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [le] lui a imposé.
fr.B: Qu’il s’asseye à l’écart et garde le silence \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lui a imposé.
fr.R: Quand Dieu met cette charge sur lui, \q il devrait s’asseoir seul et rester silencieux.

es.L: Que se siente solo y calle, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [se lo] ha impuesto.
es.B: Que se siente aparte y guarde silencio \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se lo haya impuesto.
es.R: Cuando Dios le pone esa carga, \q debe sentarse solo y quedarse callado.

vi.L: Hãy để người ngồi một mình và im lặng, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt [ách] trên người.
vi.B: Hãy để người ngồi một mình và im lặng \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt ách ấy trên người.
vi.R: Khi Đức Chúa Trời đặt gánh nặng ấy trên người, \q người nên ngồi một mình và yên lặng.

sw.L: Na aketi peke yake na kunyamaza, \q kwa maana ameiweka juu yake.
sw.B: Na akae peke yake na kunyamaza \q wakati amemtwika nira hiyo.
sw.R: Mungu anapomtwika mzigo huo, \q anapaswa kukaa peke yake na kunyamaza.

ko.L: 그는 홀로 앉아 잠잠히 있을 일이다, \q 그분께서 [그것을] 그에게 지우셨으니.
ko.B: 그는 홀로 앉아 잠잠히 있을 일이다, \q 그분께서 그에게 그 짐을 지우셨을 때에는.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그에게 그 짐을 지우시면 \q 그는 혼자 앉아 조용히 있어야 한다.

decisions.choice: tenth letter: yod (verses 28-30)
decisions.reason: Verses 28-30 each begin with yod, the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: he has laid it: God has put the yoke on him
alternatives: when it is laid on him
decisions.reason: The one who lays the yoke is not named; it is most likely the LORD, who is the subject of the whole chapter's 'he'. It could also be read without a named subject: 'when it is laid on him'.

decisions.choice: let him sit ... be silent: advice, not command
decisions.reason: The verbs in verses 28-30 express what is fitting: this is what such a man should do.

decisions.choice: God puts that load on him
decisions.reason: Readable names God (m2) and says what is laid on him (the yoke of verse 27), and puts the 'when' clause first.

decisions.choice: "él" written out for God
decisions.reason: Spanish could leave the subject in the verb, but here two men are in view, so Literal and Balanced write "él" for God, with its span, to keep him apart from the young man who bears the yoke.

source.text: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽעָפָר֙ פִּ֔יהוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Let him put in the dust his mouth; perhaps there is hope.

en.L: Let him put his mouth in the dust; \q perhaps there is hope.
en.B: Let him lie with his face in the dust; \q there may still be hope for him.
en.R: He should bow down with his face to the ground. \q There may still be hope.

pt.L: Que ele ponha a sua boca no pó; \q talvez haja esperança.
pt.B: Que ele se deite com o rosto no pó; \q talvez ainda haja esperança para ele.
pt.R: Ele deve se curvar com o rosto no chão. \q Ainda pode haver esperança.

fr.L: Qu’il mette sa bouche dans la poussière ; \q peut-être y a-t-il de l’espoir.
fr.B: Qu’il se couche le visage dans la poussière ; \q il y a peut-être encore de l’espoir pour lui.
fr.R: Il devrait se prosterner le visage contre terre. \q Il y a peut-être encore de l’espoir.

es.L: Que ponga su boca en el polvo; \q quizás haya esperanza.
es.B: Que se postre con el rostro en el polvo; \q tal vez aún haya esperanza para él.
es.R: Debe inclinarse con la cara hasta el suelo. \q Tal vez todavía haya esperanza.

vi.L: Hãy để người đặt miệng mình trong bụi đất; \q có lẽ còn hy vọng.
vi.B: Hãy để người nằm sấp mặt trong bụi đất; \q biết đâu người vẫn còn hy vọng.
vi.R: Người nên cúi rạp mặt xuống đất. \q Có thể vẫn còn hy vọng.

sw.L: Na atie kinywa chake mavumbini; \q huenda kuna tumaini.
sw.B: Na alale kifudifudi mavumbini; \q huenda bado kuna tumaini kwake.
sw.R: Anapaswa kuinama mpaka uso wake ufike chini. \q Huenda bado kuna tumaini.

ko.L: 그는 자기 입을 티끌에 댈 일이다. \q 혹시 소망이 있을지 모른다.
ko.B: 그는 얼굴을 티끌에 대고 엎드릴 일이다. \q 아직 그에게 희망이 있을지 모른다.
ko.R: 그는 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려야 한다. \q 아직 희망이 있을지도 모른다.

decisions.choice: put his mouth in the dust: bow down to the ground in submission
decisions.reason: To lie face down with the mouth in the dust is the posture of someone who submits completely and says nothing in his own defense (compare Psalm 72:9; Micah 7:17).

decisions.choice: perhaps: hope without presuming
decisions.reason: The man does not claim that God must act. He hopes humbly that he will, as in Joel 2:14 and Zephaniah 2:3.

decisions.choice: lie with his face in the dust / bow down with his face to the ground
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say 'face' for 'mouth' and Readable explains the posture (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Let him give to [the one] striking him a cheek; let him be filled with disgrace.

en.L: Let him give [his] cheek to the one who strikes him; \q let him be sated with disgrace.
en.B: Let him offer his cheek to the one who strikes him \q and take his fill of insults.
en.R: He should let people slap his face \q and insult him as much as they want.

pt.L: Que ele dê [a] face a quem o fere; \q que se farte de afronta.
pt.B: Que ele ofereça a face a quem lhe bate \q e se farte de insultos.
pt.R: Ele deve deixar que lhe deem tapas no rosto \q e que o insultem quanto quiserem.

fr.L: Qu’il tende [sa] joue à celui qui le frappe ; \q qu’il soit rassasié d’opprobre.
fr.B: Qu’il tende la joue à celui qui le frappe \q et qu’il se laisse abreuver d’insultes.
fr.R: Il devrait laisser les gens le gifler \q et l’insulter autant qu’ils le veulent.

es.L: Que dé [su] mejilla al que lo golpea; \q que se sacie de afrenta.
es.B: Que ofrezca la mejilla al que lo golpea \q y se harte de insultos.
es.R: Debe dejar que le den bofetadas \q y que lo insulten todo lo que quieran.

vi.L: Hãy để người đưa má cho kẻ vả mình; \q hãy để người chịu sỉ nhục no nê.
vi.B: Hãy để người đưa má cho kẻ vả mình \q và chịu đầy sự sỉ nhục.
vi.R: Người nên để cho người ta tát vào mặt mình \q và sỉ nhục mình bao nhiêu tùy ý.

sw.L: Na ampe shavu [lake] yeye ampigaye; \q na ashibishwe aibu.
sw.B: Na amgeuzie shavu lake yule anayempiga \q na akubali matusi tele.
sw.R: Anapaswa kuwaacha watu wampige makofi usoni \q na kumtukana kadiri wanavyotaka.

ko.L: 그는 자기를 치는 자에게 뺨을 내줄 일이다. \q 수치로 배를 채울 일이다.
ko.B: 그는 자기를 치는 사람에게 뺨을 내밀고 \q 모욕을 실컷 받을 일이다.
ko.R: 그는 사람들이 자기 뺨을 때려도 내버려 두고, \q 그들이 마음껏 모욕해도 참아야 한다.

decisions.choice: the cheek: a blow of insult
decisions.reason: A slap on the cheek was an insult and a public humiliation as much as a hurt (1 Kings 22:24; Job 16:10; Micah 4:14).

decisions.choice: giving the cheek: the servant of Isaiah 50:6, and Jesus' teaching
decisions.reason: The servant in Isaiah gives his back to those who strike him and his cheeks to those who pull out the beard (Isaiah 50:6). Jesus tells his followers to turn the other cheek (Matthew 5:39).

decisions.choice: disgrace: reproach, insult
decisions.reason: The word (cherpah) is scorn heaped on someone. To be filled with it is to bear all of it.

records.literal_gloss: For not will reject forever [the] Lord.

en.L: For not forever \q does the Lord cast off.
en.B: For the Lord does not cast people off \q for all time.
en.R: The Lord will not turn {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} back on us \q forever.

pt.L: Pois não para sempre \q o Senhor rejeita.
pt.B: Pois o Senhor não rejeita ninguém \q para sempre.
pt.R: O Senhor não vai nos dar as costas \q para sempre.

fr.L: Car ce n’est pas pour toujours \q que le Seigneur rejette.
fr.B: Car le Seigneur ne rejette pas les gens \q pour toujours.
fr.R: Le Seigneur ne nous tournera pas le dos \q pour toujours.

es.L: Porque no para siempre \q desecha el Señor.
es.B: Porque el Señor no rechaza a nadie \q para siempre.
es.R: El Señor no nos dará la espalda \q para siempre.

vi.L: Vì không phải đời đời \q Chúa từ bỏ.
vi.B: Vì Chúa không ruồng bỏ người ta \q mãi mãi.
vi.R: Chúa sẽ không quay lưng với chúng ta \q mãi mãi.

sw.L: Kwa maana si milele \q Bwana anatupa mbali.
sw.B: Kwa maana Bwana hawatupi watu mbali \q milele.
sw.R: Bwana hatatugeuzia kisogo \q milele.

ko.L: 참으로 영원히는 \q 주님께서 버리지 않으신다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 사람을 \q 영원히 버리지 않으신다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 우리를 \q 영원히 외면하지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: eleventh letter: kaph (verses 31-33)
decisions.reason: Verses 31-33 each begin with kaph, the eleventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1). Each of the three begins with 'for' (ki), giving the reasons for the patience of verses 26-30.

decisions.choice: cast off: reject, push away
decisions.reason: The verb (zanach) is the one used of the soul cast away from peace in verse 17; it is also the complaint of Psalm 77:8. The rejection the man felt will not last.

decisions.choice: no object: whom he will not cast off is left open
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. It means the man of verses 27-30 and anyone like him, and so God's people.

decisions.choice: people / us
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies 'people' and Readable 'us', the people for whom the man speaks (m3).

records.literal_gloss: For though he has caused grief, and he will have compassion according to [the] abundance of his loyal loves.

en.L: For if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has caused grief, then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will have compassion \q according to the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love.
en.B: Though {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings grief, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will show compassion, \q so great is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love.
en.R: He may bring sorrow, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will also show mercy, \q because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is so great.

pt.L: Pois, se {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} causou aflição, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} terá compaixão \q segundo a grandeza dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} [atos de] amor leal.
pt.B: Mesmo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cause tristeza, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrará compaixão, \q tão grande é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal.
pt.R: Ele pode trazer tristeza, mas também vai mostrar misericórdia, \q porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel é muito grande.

fr.L: Car s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a affligé, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura compassion \q selon la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Même s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} afflige, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura compassion, \q tant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est grand.
fr.R: Il peut causer du chagrin, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montrera aussi {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tendresse, \q parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est très grand.

es.L: Porque si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha causado aflicción, también tendrá compasión \q conforme a la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal.
es.B: Aunque cause dolor, tendrá compasión, \q tan grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel.
es.R: Él puede traer tristeza, pero también tendrá compasión, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es muy grande.

vi.L: Vì nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gây sầu khổ, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thương xót \q theo sự lớn lao của tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gây sầu khổ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng sẽ tỏ lòng thương xót, \q vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.
vi.R: Ngài có thể để cho buồn khổ đến, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng sẽ tỏ lòng thương xót, \q vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.

sw.L: Kwa maana ingawa ameleta huzuni, ataonyesha huruma \q kwa kadiri ya wingi wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Ingawa huleta huzuni, ataonyesha huruma, \q kwa kuwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu.
sw.R: Huenda akaleta huzuni, lakini pia ataonyesha huruma, \q kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu sana.

ko.L: 그분께서 근심하게 하셨어도 불쌍히 여기실 것이다, \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑의 크심을 따라.
ko.B: 그분께서 슬픔을 주실지라도 불쌍히 여기신다. \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 그토록 크기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 슬픔을 주실 때도 있지만 다시 불쌍히 여기신다. \q 그분의 변함없는 사랑이 너무나 크기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: have compassion: the verb of the 'mercies' of verse 22
decisions.reason: The verb (racham) is from the same root as the 'mercies' (rachamim) of verse 22: the tender love of a parent (Psalm 103:13).

decisions.choice: his loyal love: plural in the reading marked in the margin
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text read 'his loyal love' in the singular; the reading marked in the margin, followed here, is the plural, 'his acts of loyal love', as in verse 22. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: though he causes grief: grief is real, but it is not his last word
decisions.reason: The poem does not deny that the LORD has brought the grief; it says his compassion will follow, and verse 33 gives the reason.

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 22.

decisions.choice: "tendrá compasión"
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of the "compasiones" of verse 22, and it is set beside loyal love again, so Spanish uses the same word family for it.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִלִּבּ֔וֹ וַיַּגֶּ֖ה בְנֵי־אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: For not he has afflicted from his heart and grieved [the] sons of man.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has not afflicted from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart \q or grieved {{gender:the children of humankind|the sons of man}}.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not bring affliction willingly \q or grief to {{gender:human beings|the sons of men}}.
en.R: He does not want to make {{gender:people|men}} suffer \q or to hurt them.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não aflige do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} coração \q nem entristece {{gender:os filhos da humanidade|os filhos dos homens}}.
pt.B: Pois não é de boa vontade que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} traz aflição \q ou tristeza {{gender:aos seres humanos|aos filhos dos homens}}.
pt.R: Ele não tem prazer em fazer {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} sofrerem \q nem em causar dor.

fr.L: Car ce n’est pas de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} afflige \q et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} attriste les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils de l’homme}}.
fr.B: Car ce n’est pas de bon cœur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait souffrir \q et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} afflige {{gender:les êtres humains|les fils des hommes}}.
fr.R: Il ne veut pas faire souffrir {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} \q ni leur faire du mal.

es.L: Porque no aflige desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón \q ni entristece a {{gender:los hijos de la humanidad|los hijos de los hombres}}.
es.B: Porque no trae aflicción por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gusto \q ni dolor a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}.
es.R: Él no quiere hacer sufrir a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} \q ni hacerles daño.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không gây hoạn nạn từ lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q hay làm sầu khổ con cái loài người.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không vui lòng gây hoạn nạn \q hay đem sầu khổ cho loài người.
vi.R: Ngài không muốn làm cho con người phải đau khổ \q hay làm tổn thương họ.

sw.L: Kwa maana hatesi kutoka moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} \q wala kuwahuzunisha wanadamu.
sw.B: Kwa maana haleti mateso kwa kupenda \q wala huzuni kwa wanadamu.
sw.R: Hapendi kuwatesa watu \q wala kuwaumiza.

ko.L: 그분께서는 마음에서 우러나 괴롭게 하지 않으시며, \q {{gender:사람의 자녀들을|사람의 아들들을}} 근심하게 하지 않으신다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 기꺼이 고난을 주시거나 \q 사람들을 근심하게 하시는 분이 아니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 사람들이 고통당하기를 바라지 않으시고, \q 그들을 아프게 하기를 원하지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: from his heart: willingly, as what he wants
decisions.reason: To do something 'from the heart' is to do it because one wants to (Numbers 16:28). God sends affliction when he must, but it is not what he desires (Ezekiel 18:23, 32).

decisions.choice: the sons of man: human beings
decisions.reason: The phrase (bene 'ish) means people in general, men and women alike.

decisions.choice: afflict: the verb of the 'affliction' of verse 1
decisions.reason: The verb ('innah) is from the root of the 'affliction' the man has seen (verses 1 and 19). Even that was not God's heart's wish.

decisions.choice: gender span for "the sons of man"
decisions.reason: The phrase means human beings, women as well as men; Spanish has an inclusive wording and a traditional one, as in the Spanish Psalms (los hijos de la humanidad / los hijos de los hombres).

decisions.choice: No gender span: "con cái loài người" (Literal), "loài người" (Balanced), "con người" (Readable)
alternatives: A gender span offering "con trai loài người" as the traditional form
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span here, but the Vietnamese words already include men and women alike, so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: "wanadamu" (L, B), "watu" (R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span with "wana wa mwanadamu" as the traditional option
decisions.reason: Where the English offers "the children of humankind" against "the sons of man", Swahili "wanadamu" and "watu" already include men and women alike, and the only other wording would change the sense, so the Swahili has no gender span here or elsewhere in the book.

decisions.choice: no gender span at Balanced and Readable: "사람들"
decisions.reason: Korean "사람들" already includes everyone, so only Literal, which keeps the Hebrew "sons of man", has two wordings to offer, as in the Korean Psalms.

source.text: לְדַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: To crush under his feet all [the] prisoners of [the] land,

en.L: To crush under his feet \q all the prisoners of the land,
en.B: When all the prisoners in the land \q are crushed underfoot,
en.R: Some people crush prisoners \q under their feet.

pt.L: Esmagar debaixo dos seus pés \q todos os prisioneiros da terra,
pt.B: Quando todos os prisioneiros da terra \q são esmagados debaixo dos pés,
pt.R: Há pessoas que esmagam prisioneiros \q debaixo dos pés.

fr.L: Écraser sous ses pieds \q tous les prisonniers du pays,
fr.B: Quand on écrase sous ses pieds \q tous les prisonniers du pays,
fr.R: Certains écrasent des prisonniers \q sous leurs pieds.

es.L: Aplastar bajo sus pies \q a todos los presos de la tierra,
es.B: Cuando a todos los presos del país \q se los aplasta bajo los pies,
es.R: Hay quienes aplastan a los presos \q bajo sus pies.

vi.L: Để nghiền nát dưới chân mình \q mọi tù nhân trong xứ,
vi.B: Khi mọi tù nhân trong xứ \q bị giày đạp dưới chân,
vi.R: Có những kẻ giày đạp các tù nhân \q dưới chân mình.

sw.L: Kuwaponda chini ya miguu yake \q wafungwa wote wa nchi,
sw.B: Wafungwa wote wa nchi \q wanapopondwa chini ya miguu,
sw.R: Watu wengine huwaponda wafungwa \q chini ya miguu yao.

ko.L: 땅의 모든 갇힌 자들을 \q 발아래 짓밟는 것,
ko.B: 땅에 갇힌 모든 사람이 \q 발아래 짓밟힐 때,
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 갇힌 사람들을 \q 발로 짓밟는다.

decisions.choice: twelfth letter: lamed (verses 34-36)
decisions.reason: Verses 34-36 each begin with lamed, the twelfth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1). Each of the three begins with the small word 'to' (le), three cases of injustice that lead up to the end of verse 36.

decisions.choice: to crush ...: verses 34-36 are one sentence
decisions.reason: Three phrases ('to crush', 'to turn aside', 'to wrong') name the wrongs, and the end of verse 36 says what the Lord thinks of them. 'His feet' are those of whoever does the crushing.

decisions.choice: the prisoners of the land: captives, perhaps the exiles
decisions.reason: These may be prisoners anywhere on earth, or the captives of the land of Judah, taken by the conqueror (1:3; 1:18). The word for land ('erets) can mean either.

decisions.choice: Some people crush ...
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long sentence of verses 34-36 into short statements and brings them together at the end of verse 36.

records.literal_gloss: To turn aside [the] justice [of] a man before [the] face of [the] Most High,

en.L: to turn aside the justice due a man \q before the face of the Most High,
en.B: when anyone is denied justice \q in the presence of the Most High,
en.R: Some deny others their rights \q right in front of the Most High God.

pt.L: desviar o direito de um homem \q diante da face do Altíssimo,
pt.B: quando alguém tem a justiça negada \q na presença do Altíssimo,
pt.R: Há quem negue aos outros os seus direitos \q bem diante do Deus Altíssimo.

fr.L: faire dévier le droit d’un homme \q devant la face du Très-Haut,
fr.B: quand on refuse à quelqu’un la justice \q en présence du Très-Haut,
fr.R: Certains privent les autres de leurs droits \q juste sous les yeux du Très-Haut.

es.L: torcer el derecho del hombre \q delante del rostro del Altísimo,
es.B: cuando a alguien se le niega su derecho \q en presencia del Altísimo,
es.R: Hay quienes niegan a otros sus derechos \q justo delante del Dios Altísimo.

vi.L: để bẻ cong công lý dành cho một người \q trước mặt Đấng Chí Cao,
vi.B: khi có người bị tước mất công lý \q trước mặt Đấng Chí Cao,
vi.R: Có những kẻ tước đoạt quyền lợi của người khác \q ngay trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Chí Cao.

sw.L: kupotosha haki ya mtu \q mbele ya uso wa Aliye Juu Kabisa,
sw.B: mtu anaponyimwa haki yake \q mbele za Aliye Juu Kabisa,
sw.R: Wengine huwanyima wenzao haki zao \q mbele ya macho ya Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa.

ko.L: 지극히 높으신 분의 얼굴 앞에서 \q 사람에게 돌아갈 정의를 굽게 하는 것,
ko.B: 지극히 높으신 분 앞에서 \q 누군가가 정의를 빼앗길 때,
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 가장 높으신 하나님 바로 앞에서 \q 다른 사람의 권리를 빼앗는다.

decisions.choice: turn aside justice: deny someone their rights
decisions.reason: To 'bend' or 'turn aside' justice is to twist a legal case against someone who should win it (Exodus 23:6; Deuteronomy 16:19).

decisions.choice: the Most High: a title for God as ruler over all
decisions.reason: The title ('elyon) speaks of God as supreme over every power (Genesis 14:19; Psalm 47:3). Injustice done 'before his face' is done where he sees it, perhaps in a court that claims to judge in his name.

decisions.choice: a man: anyone
decisions.reason: The word (geber) here means any person who is wronged.

decisions.choice: anyone / others
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say 'anyone' or 'others' for the man wronged, since any person is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: the Most High God
decisions.reason: Readable adds 'God' so that the title is clear.

decisions.choice: "le Très-Haut" at Readable too
decisions.reason: French "le Très-Haut" is already plainly a name of God, so Readable keeps the title, as at every level in these books, where the English Readable adds "God".

decisions.choice: "Aliye Juu Kabisa" (L, B), "Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa" (R) for 'elyon
decisions.reason: The title used for 'elyon in Genesis 14, Deuteronomy 32:8, the Psalms and Luke; Readable adds "Mungu" as the English Readable adds "God". Also in verse 38.

source.text: לְעַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּרִיב֔וֹ אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: To wrong a person in his lawsuit, [the] Lord not has seen.

en.L: to wrong a person in his lawsuit— \q the Lord does not look [on it with approval].
en.B: when someone is cheated in a lawsuit— \q the Lord does not approve.
en.R: Some cheat others in court. \q The Lord does not approve of any of this.

pt.L: prejudicar uma pessoa na sua causa — \q o Senhor não vê [isso com aprovação].
pt.B: quando alguém é lesado num processo — \q o Senhor não aprova.
pt.R: Há quem engane os outros no tribunal. \q O Senhor não aprova nada disso.

fr.L: léser quelqu’un dans sa cause — \q le Seigneur ne [le] regarde pas [avec faveur].
fr.B: quand on lèse quelqu’un dans son procès — \q le Seigneur ne l’approuve pas.
fr.R: Certains trichent contre les autres au tribunal. \q Le Seigneur n’approuve rien de tout cela.

es.L: perjudicar a una persona en su pleito: \q el Señor no [lo] mira [con agrado].
es.B: cuando a alguien se le hace trampa en un juicio, \q el Señor no lo aprueba.
es.R: Hay quienes engañan a otros en los tribunales. \q El Señor no aprueba nada de esto.

vi.L: để làm thiệt hại một người trong vụ kiện của người— \q Chúa không nhìn [mà chấp thuận].
vi.B: khi có người bị lừa gạt trong vụ kiện— \q Chúa không chấp nhận điều đó.
vi.R: Có những kẻ lừa gạt người khác trước tòa. \q Chúa không chấp nhận bất cứ điều nào như thế.

sw.L: kumdhulumu mtu katika kesi yake— \q Bwana haoni [hilo kwa kibali].
sw.B: mtu anapodanganywa katika kesi— \q Bwana hapendezwi.
sw.R: Wengine huwadhulumu wenzao mahakamani. \q Bwana hapendezwi na lolote kati ya hayo.

ko.L: 송사에서 사람을 억울하게 하는 것을 \q 주님께서는 [좋게] 보지 않으신다.
ko.B: 누군가가 재판에서 억울한 일을 당할 때, \q 주님께서는 그것을 좋게 여기지 않으신다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 재판에서 남을 속인다. \q 주님께서는 이런 일을 하나도 좋게 여기지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: the Lord does not approve: 'see' in the sense of looking on with favor
alternatives: Does the Lord not see it?
decisions.reason: The words are literally 'the Lord has not seen'. Here they are taken to mean that he does not look on these wrongs with approval (compare Habakkuk 1:13). They may also be a question: 'does the Lord not see?', meaning that he sees it all and will judge it (verses 59-60).

decisions.choice: wrong: make crooked, pervert
decisions.reason: The verb ('iwwet) means to bend or make crooked, here to twist someone's case at law (Job 8:3; Psalm 146:9).

decisions.choice: look [on it with approval]
decisions.reason: Literal keeps 'look' and brackets what the sense of 'seeing' requires (m1).

decisions.choice: of any of this
decisions.reason: Readable gathers the three wrongs of verses 34-36 under one statement.

source.text: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַתֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] this [who] spoke and it came to be, [if the] Lord not commanded?

en.L: Who [is] this [who] has spoken and it came to be, \q [if] the Lord has not commanded [it]?
en.B: Who can speak and make it happen \q if the Lord has not ordered it?
en.R: No one can say what will happen and make it come true \q unless the Lord has ordered it.

pt.L: Quem [é] este [que] falou e aconteceu, \q [se] o Senhor não [o] ordenou?
pt.B: Quem pode falar e fazer acontecer \q se o Senhor não ordenou?
pt.R: Ninguém pode dizer o que vai acontecer e fazer isso se cumprir \q se o Senhor não mandou.

fr.L: Qui [est] celui-ci [qui] a parlé, et cela a été, \q [si] le Seigneur n’a pas ordonné [cela] ?
fr.B: Qui peut parler et faire que cela arrive \q si le Seigneur ne l’a pas commandé ?
fr.R: Personne ne peut annoncer ce qui va arriver et le faire arriver \q si le Seigneur ne l’a pas ordonné.

es.L: ¿Quién [es] este [que] ha hablado y sucedió, \q [si] el Señor no [lo] ha mandado?
es.B: ¿Quién puede hablar y hacer que algo suceda \q si el Señor no lo ha ordenado?
es.R: Nadie puede anunciar lo que va a pasar y hacer que se cumpla \q si el Señor no lo ha ordenado.

vi.L: Ai [là] người đã nói và điều ấy xảy ra, \q [nếu] Chúa không truyền lệnh?
vi.B: Ai có thể nói mà điều ấy thành, \q nếu Chúa không truyền lệnh?
vi.R: Không ai có thể nói trước điều gì sẽ xảy ra mà làm cho nó thành sự thật, \q trừ khi Chúa đã truyền lệnh.

sw.L: Ni nani huyu aliyesema na ikawa, \q [kama] Bwana hakuamuru [hivyo]?
sw.B: Ni nani awezaye kusema jambo na likatokea \q kama Bwana hajaliamuru?
sw.R: Hakuna mtu awezaye kusema jambo litakalotokea na likatimia \q isipokuwa Bwana ameliamuru.

ko.L: 누가 말하여 그대로 되었느냐, \q 주님께서 명령하지 않으셨는데?
ko.B: 누가 말한다고 그대로 이루어지겠느냐, \q 주님께서 명령하지 않으셨다면?
ko.R: 아무도 앞일을 말하고 그대로 이루어지게 할 수 없다. \q 주님께서 명령하셔야만 그렇게 된다.

decisions.choice: thirteenth letter: mem (verses 37-39)
decisions.reason: Verses 37-39 each begin with mem, the thirteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: spoke and it came to be: the language of creation
decisions.reason: God spoke and the world came to be (Genesis 1:3; Psalm 33:9). No one else's word has that power unless God has decreed it, which includes the threats of Jerusalem's enemies (2:17).

decisions.choice: who is this: a question expecting the answer 'no one'
decisions.reason: The question means that no one can make his word come true by himself.

decisions.choice: No one can ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into a statement (m3).

source.text: מִפִּ֤י עֶלְיוֹן֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָרָע֖וֹת וְהַטּֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] mouth of [the] Most High not goes out the bad [things] and the good?

en.L: From the mouth of the Most High \q do not the calamities and the good go out?
en.B: Do not disaster and good alike \q come out of the mouth of the Most High?
en.R: Do not both bad times and good times \q come at the word of the Most High God?

pt.L: Da boca do Altíssimo \q não saem as desgraças e o bem?
pt.B: Não é da boca do Altíssimo \q que saem tanto a desgraça como o bem?
pt.R: Não é pela palavra do Deus Altíssimo \q que vêm tanto os tempos ruins como os tempos bons?

fr.L: De la bouche du Très-Haut \q ne sortent-ils pas, les malheurs et le bien ?
fr.B: Le malheur et le bonheur \q ne sortent-ils pas tous deux de la bouche du Très-Haut ?
fr.R: Les mauvais moments comme les bons \q ne viennent-ils pas sur l’ordre du Très-Haut ?

es.L: ¿De la boca del Altísimo \q no salen los males y el bien?
es.B: ¿No salen de la boca del Altísimo \q tanto la desgracia como el bien?
es.R: ¿No vienen por la palabra del Dios Altísimo \q tanto los tiempos malos como los buenos?

vi.L: Từ miệng Đấng Chí Cao \q chẳng phải tai họa và điều lành đều ra sao?
vi.B: Chẳng phải cả tai họa lẫn phúc lành \q đều ra từ miệng Đấng Chí Cao sao?
vi.R: Chẳng phải cả lúc khốn khó lẫn lúc tốt đẹp \q đều đến theo lời của Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Chí Cao sao?

sw.L: Je, kutoka kinywani mwa Aliye Juu Kabisa \q hayatoki mabaya na mema?
sw.B: Je, maafa na mema pia \q hayatoki kinywani mwa Aliye Juu Kabisa?
sw.R: Je, nyakati mbaya na nyakati njema \q hazitokei kwa neno la Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa?

ko.L: 지극히 높으신 분의 입에서 \q 재앙과 복이 나오지 않느냐?
ko.B: 재앙도 복도 \q 지극히 높으신 분의 입에서 나오지 않느냐?
ko.R: 나쁜 일도 좋은 일도 \q 가장 높으신 하나님의 말씀으로 오지 않느냐?

decisions.choice: calamities and good: disaster and blessing both come by God's word
decisions.reason: The word for the bad things (ra'ot) here means troubles and disasters, not moral wickedness. As in Isaiah 45:7 and Amos 3:6, the poem says that nothing, not even the calamity that fell on Jerusalem, happens apart from the word of the sovereign God (verse 37; 2:17). It does not say that God does wrong; verses 33-36 have just said that he does not afflict willingly or approve injustice. The point is that the one who sent the disaster can also send good.

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer 'yes'
decisions.reason: The question with 'not' means: surely both come from his mouth.

decisions.choice: calamities / disaster / bad times
decisions.reason: The word is not rendered 'evil', which would suggest moral wrong (m1).

decisions.choice: the Most High God
decisions.reason: As in verse 35.

decisions.choice: as desgraças / a desgraça / os tempos ruins
decisions.reason: As in the English, the word is not "o mal", which in Portuguese would suggest moral evil (m1); "desgraça" is disaster.

records.literal_gloss: Why should complain a person living, a man, over his sins?

en.L: Why should a living human complain, \q a man, about his sins?
en.B: Why should any living person complain, \q anyone punished for their sins?
en.R: Why should people who are still alive complain \q when they are punished for their sins?

pt.L: Por que se queixaria um ser humano vivo, \q um homem, por causa dos seus pecados?
pt.B: Por que haveria de se queixar qualquer pessoa viva, \q qualquer um castigado pelos seus pecados?
pt.R: Por que as pessoas que ainda estão vivas reclamam \q quando são castigadas pelos seus pecados?

fr.L: Pourquoi un être humain vivant se plaindrait-il, \q un homme, au sujet de ses péchés ?
fr.B: Pourquoi un vivant se plaindrait-il, \q quelqu’un qui est puni pour ses péchés ?
fr.R: Pourquoi des gens encore en vie se plaindraient-ils \q quand ils sont punis pour leurs péchés ?

es.L: ¿Por qué se queja el ser humano viviente, \q el hombre, por sus pecados?
es.B: ¿Por qué ha de quejarse cualquier persona que vive, \q cualquiera que es castigado por sus pecados?
es.R: ¿Por qué se quejan los que todavía están vivos \q cuando son castigados por sus pecados?

vi.L: Sao một người đang sống lại phàn nàn, \q một người, về tội lỗi mình?
vi.B: Sao người đang sống lại phàn nàn, \q khi bị phạt vì tội lỗi mình?
vi.R: Sao những người còn sống lại phàn nàn \q khi họ bị phạt vì tội lỗi của mình?

sw.L: Kwa nini mwanadamu aliye hai alalamike, \q mtu, kuhusu dhambi zake?
sw.B: Kwa nini mtu yeyote aliye hai alalamike, \q mtu anayeadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zake?
sw.R: Kwa nini watu walio bado hai walalamike \q wanapoadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao?

ko.L: 살아 있는 사람이 어찌 불평하겠느냐, \q 사람이 자기 죄 때문에?
ko.B: 살아 있는 사람이 어찌 불평하겠느냐? \q 자기 죄 때문에 벌을 받는 사람이 어찌 불평하겠느냐?
ko.R: 아직 살아 있는 사람이 왜 불평하느냐? \q 자기 죄 때문에 벌을 받는 것인데.

decisions.choice: complain about his sins: complain at the punishment of one's own sins
alternatives: Why should a living person complain? Let each one grieve over his own sins.
decisions.reason: The short Hebrew line can be read as 'why should anyone complain when he is punished for his sins?', or as two parts: 'why should a living person complain? Let a man complain about his own sins!' Either way, the complaint is turned from God to one's own wrongdoing, which leads into the confession of verses 40-42.

decisions.choice: living: still alive, by God's mercy
decisions.reason: To be alive at all is a gift after the disaster, as verse 22 has said.

decisions.choice: his sins: plural in the reading marked in the margin
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text read 'his sin'; the reading marked in the margin, followed here, has 'his sins'. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: anyone ... their / people ... they
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use inclusive words, since anyone is meant; Literal keeps 'a man' (geber).

records.literal_gloss: Let us search our ways and let us examine, and let us return to Yahweh.

en.L: Let us search out our ways and examine [them], \q and let us return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Let us look hard at the way we live and test it, \q and turn back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Let us look closely at how we have been living \q and come back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: Examinemos os nossos caminhos e [os] investiguemos, \q e voltemos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Olhemos com atenção para o modo como vivemos e ponhamos isso à prova, \q e voltemos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Vamos olhar com cuidado para a maneira como temos vivido \q e voltar {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}.

fr.L: Recherchons nos voies et examinons[-les], \q et revenons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Examinons de près notre conduite et mettons-la à l’épreuve, \q et revenons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Regardons attentivement comment nous avons vécu, \q et revenons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

es.L: Escudriñemos nuestros caminos y [los] examinemos, \q y volvamos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Examinemos a fondo nuestra manera de vivir y pongámosla a prueba, \q y volvámonos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Miremos con cuidado cómo hemos estado viviendo \q y volvamos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy dò xét các đường lối mình và xem xét [chúng], \q và chúng ta hãy trở lại cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Chúng ta hãy xét kỹ cách mình sống và thử nghiệm nó, \q rồi quay về cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Chúng ta hãy xem lại cách mình đã sống \q và ăn năn quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

sw.L: Na tuzichunguze njia zetu na kuzipima, \q tumrudie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tuitazame kwa makini njia tunayoishi na kuipima, \q tumrudie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Tuchunguze kwa makini jinsi tumekuwa tukiishi, \q tumrudie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 우리의 길들을 살피고 조사하여 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아가자.
ko.B: 우리가 살아온 길을 깊이 살피고 따져 보고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아가자.
ko.R: 우리가 어떻게 살아왔는지 잘 살펴보고 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아가자.

decisions.choice: fourteenth letter: nun (verses 40-42)
decisions.reason: Verses 40-42 each begin with nun, the fourteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: let us: the man's voice becomes the people's
decisions.reason: The verbs change from 'I' to 'we'. The man now leads the whole people in confession and prayer (verses 40-47), and in verse 48 he speaks as 'I' again. These words are not set off as a quotation.

decisions.choice: return: turn back, repent
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) means to turn around and go back. Turning back to the LORD is repentance (Deuteronomy 30:2; Hosea 14:2).

decisions.choice: our ways: how we have lived
decisions.reason: A person's ways are the conduct of their life, as in verses 9 and 11.

decisions.choice: how we have been living
decisions.reason: Readable says what 'our ways' means (m4).

decisions.choice: "revenons au SEIGNEUR" for shuv at every level
decisions.reason: The prophets’ settled French for shuv is "revenir" at every level, for repentance and return alike (m3).

decisions.choice: "volver" / "volverse"
decisions.reason: Shuv is turning back to God, worded with "volver", as in the Spanish Jeremiah, rather than with "arrepentirse".

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" (inclusive "we") as the man calls the people; "trở lại cùng" / "quay về cùng" / "ăn năn quay về với" for "return"
decisions.reason: The man now speaks with and to his people, so the inclusive "chúng ta" is needed; "return" is the turning of repentance, worded as in Jeremiah.

records.literal_gloss: Let us lift up our heart to palms to God in [the] heavens.

en.L: Let us lift up our heart along with [our] palms \q to God in the heavens.
en.B: Let us lift up our hearts as well as our hands \q to God in heaven.
en.R: Let us raise our hands to God in heaven \q and give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} our hearts as well.

pt.L: Levantemos o nosso coração junto com [as] palmas \q a Deus nos céus.
pt.B: Levantemos o nosso coração e também as nossas mãos \q a Deus, no céu.
pt.R: Vamos levantar as mãos a Deus, que está no céu, \q e entregar a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também o nosso coração.

fr.L: Élevons notre cœur avec [nos] paumes \q vers Dieu dans les cieux.
fr.B: Élevons nos cœurs en même temps que nos mains \q vers Dieu qui est au ciel.
fr.R: Levons les mains vers Dieu dans le ciel \q et donnons-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi notre cœur.

es.L: Alcemos nuestro corazón junto con [nuestras] palmas \q a Dios en los cielos.
es.B: Elevemos nuestro corazón y también nuestras manos \q a Dios que está en el cielo.
es.R: Levantemos las manos a Dios en el cielo \q y démos{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} también nuestro corazón.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy nâng lòng mình cùng với [đôi] bàn tay \q lên Đức Chúa Trời trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Chúng ta hãy nâng cả tấm lòng lẫn đôi tay \q lên Đức Chúa Trời trên trời.
vi.R: Chúng ta hãy giơ tay lên Đức Chúa Trời trên trời \q và dâng cả tấm lòng mình cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa.

sw.L: Tuinue mioyo yetu pamoja na viganja [vyetu] \q kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni.
sw.B: Tuinue mioyo yetu pamoja na mikono yetu \q kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni.
sw.R: Tuinue mikono yetu kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni \q na kumpa mioyo yetu pia.

ko.L: 우리의 마음을 손바닥과 함께 \q 하늘에 계신 하나님께 들어 올리자.
ko.B: 손뿐 아니라 마음까지 \q 하늘에 계신 하나님께 들어 올리자.
ko.R: 하늘에 계신 하나님께 두 손을 들고 \q 우리 마음도 그분께 드리자.

decisions.choice: palms: hands raised in prayer
decisions.reason: People prayed standing with their hands spread out and lifted toward heaven (1 Kings 8:22; Psalm 28:2; Lamentations 2:19).

decisions.choice: the heart with the hands: prayer that is more than a gesture
decisions.reason: The phrase is literally 'our heart to the palms'. It most likely means lifting up the heart together with the hands, so that the prayer is sincere and not only outward (compare Joel 2:13). It may also mean 'lift up our heart in our hands', offering it to God.

decisions.choice: raise our hands ... give him our hearts as well
decisions.reason: Readable puts the gesture first and then says what lifting the heart means (m2).

source.text: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֨עְנוּ֙ וּמָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: We, we have transgressed and we have rebelled; you, not you have forgiven.

en.L: As for us, we have transgressed and rebelled; \q as for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not forgiven.
en.B: We have sinned and rebelled, \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not forgiven.
en.R: We have sinned and turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not forgiven us.

pt.L: Quanto a nós, transgredimos e nos rebelamos; \q quanto a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não perdoaste.
pt.B: Nós pecamos e nos rebelamos, \q e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não perdoaste.
pt.R: Nós pecamos e nos voltamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não nos perdoaste.

fr.L: Nous, nous avons transgressé et nous nous sommes rebellés ; \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas pardonné.
fr.B: Nous avons péché et nous nous sommes rebellés, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas pardonné.
fr.R: Nous avons péché et nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne nous as pas pardonné.

es.L: Nosotros hemos transgredido y nos hemos rebelado; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no has perdonado.
es.B: Nosotros nos hemos rebelado y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos desobedecido, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no nos has perdonado.
es.R: Hemos pecado y nos hemos puesto en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} contra, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no nos has perdonado.

vi.L: Chúng con, chúng con đã vi phạm và phản nghịch; \q còn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không tha thứ.
vi.B: Chúng con đã phạm tội và phản nghịch, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không tha thứ.
vi.R: Chúng con đã phạm tội và chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không tha thứ cho chúng con.

sw.L: Sisi tumeasi na kukaidi; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hukusamehe.
sw.B: Tumeasi na kukaidi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} hukusamehe.
sw.R: Tumetenda dhambi na kukugeuka, \q {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} hukutusamehe.

ko.L: 저희는 반역하고 거역하였으나, \q 주님께서는 용서하지 않으셨습니다.
ko.B: 저희가 반역하고 거역했더니, \q 주님께서는 용서하지 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 저희가 죄를 짓고 주님께 등을 돌렸습니다. \q 그래서 주님께서는 저희를 용서하지 않으셨습니다.

decisions.choice: we ... you: the two sides set against each other
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are written out for emphasis. The people own their guilt, and they say plainly that God has not yet forgiven it.

decisions.choice: transgressed and rebelled: broken faith with God and defied him
decisions.reason: The first verb (pasha') means to rebel against a ruler and break a covenant; the second (marah) to defy or disobey (1:18, 20; Deuteronomy 9:7).

decisions.choice: you: now addressed to God
decisions.reason: From here to verse 45 the people speak directly to God.

decisions.choice: turned against you; forgiven us
decisions.reason: Readable supplies whom they rebelled against and whom God has not forgiven.

decisions.choice: "Nosotros ... tú" written out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the two pronouns against each other ("we ... you"); Spanish writes both pronouns, which it would usually leave in the verb, to keep the contrast.

decisions.choice: "chúng con" for "we" when the people speak to God (3:42–47), as in chapter 5
decisions.reason: Speaking to God as a community, Vietnamese prayer says "chúng con"; the man alone keeps "tôi", and "chúng ta" (verses 40–41) is for words to one another.

decisions.choice: 합쇼체 with "저희" from 3:42 to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: Here the people's confession is spoken to God, so "we" becomes the humble "저희" and the verbs take the prayer style, and "I" in 3:48-66 is "저". The calls of 3:40-41 are to the people and keep "우리".

source.text: סַכֹּ֤תָה בָאַף֙ וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵ֔נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: You have covered with anger and pursued us; you have killed, not you have spared.

en.L: You have covered [{{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}] with anger and pursued us; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have killed, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not spared.
en.B: You have clothed {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} in anger and chased us down; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have killed and not spared.
en.R: You were so angry, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chased after us. \q You killed us and showed no mercy.

pt.L: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cobriste de ira e nos perseguiste; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mataste, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não poupaste.
pt.B: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vestiste de ira e nos perseguiste até nos alcançar; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mataste sem poupar.
pt.R: Tu ficaste muito irado e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos perseguiste. \q Tu nos mataste e não tiveste pena.

fr.L: Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es enveloppé de colère et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as poursuivis ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as tué, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas épargné.
fr.B: Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es revêtu de colère et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as pourchassés ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as tué sans épargner.
fr.R: Tu étais si en colère, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as poursuivis. \q Tu nous as tués sans aucune pitié.

es.L: Te has cubierto de ira y nos has perseguido; \q has matado, no has tenido piedad.
es.B: Te has envuelto en ira y nos has perseguido sin descanso; \q has matado sin piedad.
es.R: Estabas tan enojado que nos perseguiste. \q Nos mataste y no tuviste piedad.

vi.L: Ngài đã lấy cơn giận phủ [mình] và đuổi theo chúng con; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không thương tiếc.
vi.B: Ngài đã khoác cơn giận vào mình và săn đuổi chúng con; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết và không thương tiếc.
vi.R: Ngài thật giận dữ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi theo chúng con. \q Ngài đã giết chúng con và chẳng chút thương xót.

sw.L: Umejifunika kwa hasira na kutufuatia; \q umeua, hukuhurumia.
sw.B: Umejivika hasira na kutufukuza; \q umeua bila huruma.
sw.R: Ulikasirika sana, ukatufukuza. \q Ulituua bila kutuonea huruma.

ko.L: 주님께서 진노로 [자신을] 덮으시고 저희를 쫓으셨으며, \q 죽이시고 아끼지 않으셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 진노를 옷처럼 두르시고 저희를 뒤쫓으셨으며, \q 사정없이 죽이셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 몹시 화가 나셔서 저희를 뒤쫓으셨습니다. \q 저희를 죽이시고 불쌍히 여기지 않으셨습니다.

decisions.choice: fifteenth letter: samekh (verses 43-45)
decisions.reason: Verses 43-45 each begin with samekh, the fifteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: covered: wrapped yourself in anger
alternatives: you have covered us with anger
decisions.reason: The verb (sakhakh) means to cover or screen. It has no object here; verse 44 has the same verb with 'yourself', which suggests God wrapping himself in anger. It could also mean that he covered the people over in anger.

decisions.choice: spared: had pity, held back
decisions.reason: The verb (chamal) means to have pity and so hold back from harm, as in 2:2, 17 and 21.

decisions.choice: You were so angry
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture of covering oneself with anger means (m2).

records.literal_gloss: You have covered with [the] cloud for yourself, from passing through [of] prayer.

en.L: You have covered {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} with a cloud, \q so that prayer cannot pass through.
en.B: You have hidden {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} behind a cloud \q that no prayer can pass through.
en.R: You covered {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} with a cloud \q so our prayers could not reach {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

pt.L: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cobriste com uma nuvem, \q para que a oração não passasse.
pt.B: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} escondeste atrás de uma nuvem \q que nenhuma oração consegue atravessar.
pt.R: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cobriste com uma nuvem \q para que as nossas orações não chegassem até {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es couvert d’un nuage, \q pour que la prière ne passe pas.
fr.B: Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es caché derrière un nuage \q qu’aucune prière ne peut traverser.
fr.R: Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es couvert d’un nuage \q pour que nos prières ne puissent pas {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}atteindre.

es.L: Te has cubierto de una nube \q para que no pase la oración.
es.B: Te has escondido tras una nube \q que ninguna oración puede atravesar.
es.R: Te cubriste con una nube \q para que nuestras oraciones no pudieran llegar hasta {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Ngài đã lấy mây che phủ mình, \q để lời cầu nguyện không thể thấu qua.
vi.B: Ngài đã ẩn mình sau đám mây \q mà không lời cầu nguyện nào có thể xuyên qua.
vi.R: Ngài đã lấy mây che mình \q để lời cầu nguyện của chúng con không thể đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

sw.L: Umejifunika kwa wingu, \q ili maombi yasipite.
sw.B: Umejificha nyuma ya wingu \q ambalo hakuna maombi yanayoweza kulipenya.
sw.R: Ulijifunika kwa wingu \q ili maombi yetu yasikufikie.

ko.L: 주님께서 구름으로 자신을 덮으셔서 \q 기도가 뚫고 지나가지 못하게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 구름 뒤에 숨으셔서 \q 어떤 기도도 뚫고 들어가지 못하게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 구름으로 몸을 가리셔서 \q 저희 기도가 주님께 닿지 못하게 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: a cloud that prayer cannot pass: the answer to verse 8
decisions.reason: Cloud often hides God's presence (Exodus 19:9; Psalm 97:2). Here it shuts out the people's prayer, as the man said of his own prayer in verse 8.

decisions.choice: so that ... not: the purpose of the cloud
decisions.reason: The preposition 'from' with the verb means 'so as to keep from'.

decisions.choice: our prayers ... reach you
decisions.reason: Readable says whose prayers and where they cannot go.

records.literal_gloss: Scum and refuse you make us in [the] midst of the peoples.

en.L: Scum and refuse {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make us \q in the midst of the peoples.
en.B: You have turned us into filth and rubbish \q among the peoples.
en.R: You have made us like trash \q in the eyes of the other nations.

pt.L: Escória e refugo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos fazes \q no meio dos povos.
pt.B: Tu nos transformaste em sujeira e lixo \q entre os povos.
pt.R: Tu nos tornaste como lixo \q aos olhos das outras nações.

fr.L: Balayure et rebut, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais de nous [cela] \q au milieu des peuples.
fr.B: Tu as fait de nous de l’ordure et des déchets \q parmi les peuples.
fr.R: Tu as fait de nous des déchets \q aux yeux des autres nations.

es.L: Escoria y desecho nos has hecho \q en medio de los pueblos.
es.B: Nos has convertido en basura y desperdicio \q entre los pueblos.
es.R: Nos has dejado como basura \q ante los ojos de las demás naciones.

vi.L: Cặn bã và rác rưởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm chúng con \q ở giữa các dân.
vi.B: Ngài đã biến chúng con thành đồ dơ bẩn và rác rưởi \q giữa các dân.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho chúng con như rác \q trước mắt các dân tộc khác.

sw.L: Takataka na uchafu umetufanya \q katikati ya mataifa.
sw.B: Umetugeuza kuwa uchafu na takataka \q kati ya mataifa.
sw.R: Umetufanya kama takataka \q machoni pa mataifa mengine.

ko.L: 주님께서 저희를 찌꺼기와 쓰레기로 만드셨습니다, \q 민족들 가운데서.
ko.B: 주님께서는 저희를 오물과 쓰레기로 만드셨습니다, \q 뭇 민족 가운데서.
ko.R: 주님께서는 저희를 쓰레기처럼 만드셨습니다. \q 다른 민족들이 저희를 그렇게 봅니다.

decisions.choice: scum: what is scraped off and thrown away
decisions.reason: The first word (sechi) is found only here; a related verb means to scrape off (Ezekiel 26:4). With 'refuse' it means what is worthless and rejected.

decisions.choice: the scum of the world: Paul's words in 1 Corinthians 4:13
decisions.reason: Paul says the apostles have become like the scum of the world, using words close to these in the Greek translation of this verse.

decisions.choice: in the eyes of the other nations
decisions.reason: Readable says 'nations' for 'peoples' and says how they see Israel.

decisions.choice: escória
decisions.reason: Paul uses words close to these in 1 Corinthians 4:13 (m2), whose Portuguese says "a escória de todos", so Literal says "escória" to keep the echo.

records.literal_gloss: They have opened against us their mouth, all our enemies.

en.L: They have opened their mouth against us, \q all our enemies.
en.B: Our enemies, every one of them, \q have opened their mouths wide against us.
en.R: All our enemies \q open their mouths to mock us.

pt.L: Abriram contra nós a sua boca \q todos os nossos inimigos.
pt.B: Os nossos inimigos, todos eles, \q escancararam a boca contra nós.
pt.R: Todos os nossos inimigos \q abrem a boca para zombar de nós.

fr.L: Ils ont ouvert la bouche contre nous, \q tous nos ennemis.
fr.B: Nos ennemis, tous autant qu’ils sont, \q ont ouvert grand la bouche contre nous.
fr.R: Tous nos ennemis \q ouvrent la bouche pour se moquer de nous.

es.L: Han abierto contra nosotros su boca \q todos nuestros enemigos.
es.B: Nuestros enemigos, todos ellos, \q han abierto la boca contra nosotros.
es.R: Todos nuestros enemigos \q abren la boca para burlarse de nosotros.

vi.L: Chúng đã há miệng nghịch cùng chúng con, \q hết thảy kẻ thù của chúng con.
vi.B: Kẻ thù của chúng con, hết thảy chúng, \q đều há rộng miệng nghịch cùng chúng con.
vi.R: Mọi kẻ thù của chúng con \q đều há miệng chế nhạo chúng con.

sw.L: Wamefumbua vinywa vyao dhidi yetu, \q adui zetu wote.
sw.B: Adui zetu, kila mmoja wao, \q wamepanua vinywa vyao dhidi yetu.
sw.R: Adui zetu wote \q wanafungua vinywa vyao kutudhihaki.

ko.L: 저희를 향해 입을 벌렸습니다, \q 저희의 모든 원수가.
ko.B: 저희 원수들이 하나같이 \q 저희를 향해 입을 크게 벌렸습니다.
ko.R: 저희 원수들이 모두 \q 입을 벌려 저희를 조롱합니다.

decisions.choice: sixteenth letter: pe (verses 46-48)
decisions.reason: Verses 46-48 each begin with pe, the sixteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1). Pe comes before ayin (verses 49-51), as in chapters 2 and 4; see the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: opened their mouth against us: as in 2:16
decisions.reason: The same words open the pe verse of chapter 2, where the enemies jeer and gnash their teeth at Jerusalem. Opening the mouth wide is a gesture of scorn (Psalm 35:21).

decisions.choice: All our enemies have opened ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the subject first; the Hebrew keeps it to the end.

decisions.choice: to mock us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gesture means (m2).

source.text: פַּ֧חַד וָפַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖נוּ הַשֵּׁ֥את וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Terror and pit has come to us, the devastation and the destruction.

en.L: Terror and pit have been ours, \q the devastation and the breaking.
en.B: Panic and the pit have overtaken us, \q ruin and collapse.
en.R: We are terrified and trapped, \q ruined and destroyed.

pt.L: Terror e cova vieram sobre nós, \q a devastação e a fratura.
pt.B: O pavor e o poço nos alcançaram, \q a ruína e o desmoronamento.
pt.R: Estamos apavorados e presos numa armadilha, \q arruinados e destruídos.

fr.L: La terreur et la fosse ont été pour nous, \q la dévastation et la ruine.
fr.B: La terreur et la fosse nous ont atteints, \q la ruine et l’effondrement.
fr.R: Nous sommes terrifiés et pris au piège, \q ruinés et détruits.

es.L: Terror y fosa nos han sobrevenido, \q la devastación y el quebranto.
es.B: El terror y la fosa nos han alcanzado, \q la ruina y el desastre.
es.R: Estamos aterrados y atrapados, \q arruinados y destruidos.

vi.L: Kinh hoàng và hố sâu đã thuộc về chúng con, \q sự tàn phá và sự tan vỡ.
vi.B: Hoảng sợ và hầm hố đã ập xuống chúng con, \q cùng với điêu tàn và đổ nát.
vi.R: Chúng con kinh hoàng và bị sập bẫy, \q bị tàn phá và hủy diệt.

sw.L: Hofu na shimo vimetupata, \q uharibifu na kuvunjika.
sw.B: Hofu kuu na shimo vimetupata, \q maangamizi na kuporomoka.
sw.R: Tumejaa hofu na tumenaswa, \q tumeharibiwa na kuangamizwa.

ko.L: 공포와 함정이 저희에게 닥쳤습니다, \q 황폐와 파멸이.
ko.B: 공포와 구덩이가 저희를 덮쳤습니다. \q 폐허와 멸망이 닥쳤습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 무서워 떨고 덫에 걸렸습니다. \q 망하고 무너졌습니다.

decisions.choice: terror and pit: a saying of the prophets
decisions.reason: The two words sound almost alike (pachad, pachat). Isaiah 24:17-18 and Jeremiah 48:43-44 add a third, 'snare': whoever escapes one danger falls into the next.

decisions.choice: devastation and destruction: ruin and breaking
decisions.reason: The first word (she't) is found only here; it is probably related to the word for ruin (sho'ah). The second (shever) is breaking or shattering, and returns in verse 48.

decisions.choice: panic and the pit
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps two words that sound alike, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: We are terrified and trapped
decisions.reason: Readable turns the nouns into words about the people.

decisions.choice: o pavor e o poço
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words sound almost alike (m1); Balanced says "o pavor e o poço", which keep the sound, as the English Balanced's "panic and the pit" does.

decisions.choice: "la terreur et la fosse"
decisions.reason: The prophets’ saying (m1) keeps the words of the published Jeremiah 48:43 and Isaiah 24:17.

decisions.choice: "terror y fosa"
decisions.reason: The pair is a saying of the prophets (Isaiah 24:17; Jeremiah 48:43), so Literal and Balanced use the words of the Spanish Isaiah and Jeremiah.

records.literal_gloss: Streams of water goes down my eye over [the] breaking of [the] daughter of my people.

en.L: My eye runs down [with] streams of water \q over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
en.B: Streams of tears flow down from my eyes \q over the destruction of my dear people.
en.R: Tears pour from my eyes like rivers \q because my people have been destroyed.

pt.L: O meu olho derrama ribeiros de água \q pela fratura da filha do meu povo.
pt.B: Rios de lágrimas correm dos meus olhos \q pela destruição do meu querido povo.
pt.R: Lágrimas descem dos meus olhos como rios, \q porque o meu povo foi destruído.

fr.L: Mon œil fait couler des ruisseaux d’eau \q sur le désastre de la fille de mon peuple.
fr.B: Des ruisseaux de larmes coulent de mes yeux \q à cause de la ruine de mon cher peuple.
fr.R: Les larmes coulent de mes yeux comme des rivières, \q parce que mon peuple a été détruit.

es.L: Corrientes de agua derrama mi ojo \q por el quebranto de la hija de mi pueblo.
es.B: Ríos de lágrimas corren de mis ojos \q por la destrucción de mi querido pueblo.
es.R: Las lágrimas corren de mis ojos como ríos \q porque mi pueblo ha sido destruido.

vi.L: Mắt tôi tuôn chảy những dòng nước \q vì sự hủy diệt của con gái của dân tôi.
vi.B: Những dòng lệ tuôn trào từ mắt tôi \q vì dân yêu dấu của tôi bị hủy diệt.
vi.R: Nước mắt tôi tuôn như sông \q vì dân tôi đã bị hủy diệt.

sw.L: Jicho langu linatiririka mito ya maji \q kwa ajili ya kuangamizwa kwa binti wa watu wangu.
sw.B: Mito ya machozi inatiririka kutoka machoni mwangu \q kwa ajili ya maangamizi ya watu wangu wapendwa.
sw.R: Machozi yanabubujika kutoka machoni mwangu kama mito \q kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa.

ko.L: 제 눈에서 물줄기가 흘러내립니다, \q 제 백성의 딸이 파멸한 것 때문에.
ko.B: 제 눈에서 눈물이 시냇물처럼 흘러내립니다. \q 사랑하는 제 백성이 멸망했기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 제 눈에서 눈물이 강물처럼 쏟아집니다. \q 제 백성이 멸망했기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: my eye: the man speaks as 'I' again
decisions.reason: After the people's prayer the man speaks for himself again, weeping over the city.

decisions.choice: the daughter of my people: the people pictured as a beloved daughter
decisions.reason: The phrase (bat-'ammi) speaks of the whole nation with tenderness, as a father of a daughter, as in 2:11 and Jeremiah 8:21.

decisions.choice: streams of water from the eye: as in Jeremiah 9:17 and Lamentations 1:16; 2:18
decisions.reason: Tears running like streams is the picture of grief that does not stop, used by Jeremiah and earlier in the book.

decisions.choice: my dear people / my people
decisions.reason: As in Jeremiah, Balanced says 'my dear people' and Readable 'my people'; Literal keeps the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: tears
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the 'water' is.

source.text: עֵינִ֧י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: My eye pours out and not ceases, from there being no respite,

en.L: My eye pours out and will not cease, \q [there being] no respite,
en.B: My eyes pour out tears and do not stop; \q they get no rest,
en.R: My tears will keep flowing. \q They will not stop

pt.L: O meu olho se derrama e não cessa, \q [porque] não há trégua,
pt.B: Os meus olhos derramam lágrimas sem parar; \q não têm descanso,
pt.R: As minhas lágrimas vão continuar correndo. \q Não vão parar

fr.L: Mon œil se répand et ne cesse pas, \q sans répit,
fr.B: Mes yeux versent des larmes sans s’arrêter ; \q ils ne trouvent aucun repos,
fr.R: Mes larmes vont continuer à couler. \q Elles ne s’arrêteront pas

es.L: Mi ojo se derrama y no cesa, \q porque no hay alivio,
es.B: Mis ojos derraman lágrimas sin parar; \q no tienen descanso,
es.R: Mis lágrimas seguirán corriendo. \q No dejarán de correr

vi.L: Mắt tôi tuôn đổ và sẽ không ngừng, \q chẳng [có] lúc nào nghỉ,
vi.B: Mắt tôi tuôn lệ mãi không ngừng; \q chẳng hề được nghỉ ngơi,
vi.R: Nước mắt tôi sẽ cứ chảy mãi. \q Chúng sẽ không ngừng

sw.L: Jicho langu linamwagika wala halitakoma, \q bila kupumzika,
sw.B: Macho yangu yanamwaga machozi bila kukoma; \q hayapati pumziko,
sw.R: Machozi yangu yataendelea kutiririka. \q Hayatakoma

ko.L: 제 눈이 쏟아지고 그치지 않으니, \q 쉼이 없습니다.
ko.B: 제 눈에서 눈물이 쏟아지고 멈추지 않습니다. \q 쉬지 않고 흐릅니다.
ko.R: 제 눈물은 계속 흐를 것입니다. \q 멈추지 않을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: seventeenth letter: ayin (verses 49-51)
decisions.reason: Verses 49-51 each begin with ayin, the seventeenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: without respite: verses 49-50 are one sentence
decisions.reason: The weeping goes on with no break (hafugot, 'stopping'), and verse 50 says how long: until the LORD looks down.

decisions.choice: pours out: flows like water
decisions.reason: The verb (nagar) is used of water poured out or running (2 Samuel 14:14; Psalm 77:3).

decisions.choice: My tears
decisions.reason: Readable says 'tears' for the flowing eye.

records.literal_gloss: until he looks down and sees, Yahweh, from heaven.

en.L: until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks down \q and sees from heaven.
en.B: until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks down \q and sees from heaven.
en.R: until {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks down from heaven \q and sees us.

pt.L: até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} olhe lá de cima \q e veja desde o céu.
pt.B: até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se incline do alto \q e veja lá do céu.
pt.R: até que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} olhe lá do céu \q e nos veja.

fr.L: jusqu’à ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde d’en haut \q et voie du haut des cieux.
fr.B: jusqu’à ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} penche pour regarder \q et voie du haut du ciel.
fr.R: jusqu’à ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde du haut du ciel \q et nous voie.

es.L: hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se incline a mirar \q y vea desde los cielos.
es.B: hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se asome \q y vea desde el cielo.
es.R: hasta que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mire desde el cielo \q y nos vea.

vi.L: cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn xuống \q và thấy từ trời.
vi.B: cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cúi nhìn xuống \q và từ trời đoái xem.
vi.R: cho đến khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ trời nhìn xuống \q và thấy chúng tôi.

sw.L: mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atazame chini \q na kuona kutoka mbinguni.
sw.B: mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atazame chini \q na kuona kutoka mbinguni.
sw.R: mpaka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atazame chini kutoka mbinguni \q na kutuona.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 굽어보시고 \q 하늘에서 살피실 때까지 [그러할 것입니다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 굽어보시고 \q 하늘에서 살펴 주실 때까지 그러할 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 내려다보시고 \q 저희를 보아 주실 때까지 그럴 것입니다.

decisions.choice: looks down and sees: God's attention to his people's trouble
decisions.reason: When God looks down from heaven and sees, he acts to help (Exodus 3:7-8; Psalm 102:20-21; Isaiah 63:15). The man will not stop weeping until that happens.

decisions.choice: looks down: bends to look from above
decisions.reason: The verb (shaqaf) is looking down from a height, as from a window (Psalm 14:2).

decisions.choice: sees us
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the LORD will see.

source.text: עֵינִי֙ עֽוֹלְלָ֣ה לְנַפְשִׁ֔י מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנ֥וֹת עִירִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: My eye has dealt severely with my soul from all [the] daughters of my city.

en.L: My eye deals harshly with my soul \q because of all the daughters of my city.
en.B: What my eyes see brings grief to my soul \q because of all the women of my city.
en.R: My heart aches at what I see \q happening to all the women of my city.

pt.L: O meu olho trata duramente a minha alma \q por causa de todas as filhas da minha cidade.
pt.B: O que os meus olhos veem traz dor à minha alma \q por causa de todas as mulheres da minha cidade.
pt.R: O meu coração dói com o que vejo \q acontecer com todas as mulheres da minha cidade.

fr.L: Mon œil fait mal à mon âme \q à cause de toutes les filles de ma ville.
fr.B: Ce que voient mes yeux m’afflige jusqu’à l’âme \q à cause de toutes les femmes de ma ville.
fr.R: J’ai mal au cœur quand je vois \q ce qui arrive à toutes les femmes de ma ville.

es.L: Mi ojo trata con dureza a mi alma \q por todas las hijas de mi ciudad.
es.B: Lo que ven mis ojos me llena el alma de dolor \q por todas las mujeres de mi ciudad.
es.R: Me duele el corazón por lo que veo \q que les pasa a todas las mujeres de mi ciudad.

vi.L: Mắt tôi làm khổ linh hồn tôi \q vì tất cả các con gái của thành tôi.
vi.B: Những gì mắt tôi thấy làm linh hồn tôi đau đớn \q vì tất cả phụ nữ trong thành tôi.
vi.R: Lòng tôi đau nhói vì những gì tôi thấy \q xảy đến cho mọi phụ nữ trong thành tôi.

sw.L: Jicho langu linaitendea nafsi yangu ukali \q kwa sababu ya binti wote wa mji wangu.
sw.B: Ninayoyaona kwa macho yangu yanaihuzunisha nafsi yangu \q kwa sababu ya wanawake wote wa mji wangu.
sw.R: Moyo wangu unauma kwa yale ninayoyaona \q yakiwapata wanawake wote wa mji wangu.

ko.L: 제 눈이 제 영혼을 괴롭게 합니다, \q 제 성읍의 모든 딸들 때문에.
ko.B: 제 눈에 보이는 것이 제 영혼을 아프게 합니다. \q 제 성읍의 모든 여자들 때문입니다.
ko.R: 제가 보는 것 때문에 마음이 아픕니다. \q 제 성읍의 모든 여자들이 당하는 일입니다.

decisions.choice: my eye deals harshly with my soul: what I see pains me
decisions.reason: The eye is the one who sees and weeps. What he sees, and his own weeping, hurt him deeply. The verb ('olel) means to treat someone harshly, as in 1:12 and 2:20.

decisions.choice: the daughters of my city: the women of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means the women and girls of the city, whose suffering the book has described (1:4, 18; 2:10, 21). 'Daughters' of a city can also mean the villages around it (Numbers 21:25), which would make it the towns of Judah.

decisions.choice: what my eyes see / what I see; the women
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the eye's harshness means (m1) and who the daughters are (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Hunting they have hunted me like the bird, my enemies, without cause.

en.L: They have hunted me down like a bird, \q those who are my enemies without cause.
en.B: People who had no reason to be my enemies \q hunted me down like a bird.
en.R: My enemies had no reason to hate me, \q but they hunted me like a bird.

pt.L: Caçaram-me como a um pássaro, \q os que são meus inimigos sem motivo.
pt.B: Pessoas que não tinham razão para ser minhas inimigas \q me caçaram como a um pássaro.
pt.R: Os meus inimigos não tinham motivo para me odiar, \q mas me caçaram como se caça um pássaro.

fr.L: Ils m’ont traqué comme un oiseau, \q ceux qui sont mes ennemis sans raison.
fr.B: Des gens qui n’avaient aucune raison d’être mes ennemis \q m’ont traqué comme un oiseau.
fr.R: Mes ennemis n’avaient aucune raison de me haïr, \q mais ils m’ont chassé comme un oiseau.

es.L: Me han cazado como a un pájaro, \q los que son mis enemigos sin causa.
es.B: Los que sin razón se hicieron mis enemigos \q me cazaron como a un pájaro.
es.R: Mis enemigos no tenían motivo para odiarme, \q pero me cazaron como a un pájaro.

vi.L: Chúng đã săn đuổi tôi như [săn] chim, \q những kẻ vô cớ làm thù tôi.
vi.B: Những kẻ chẳng có lý do gì để làm kẻ thù của tôi \q đã săn đuổi tôi như săn chim.
vi.R: Kẻ thù tôi chẳng có lý do gì để ghét tôi, \q nhưng chúng đã săn tôi như săn chim.

sw.L: Wamenisaka sana kama ndege, \q wale walio adui zangu bila sababu.
sw.B: Watu ambao hawakuwa na sababu ya kuwa adui zangu \q wamenisaka kama ndege.
sw.R: Adui zangu hawakuwa na sababu ya kunichukia, \q lakini waliniwinda kama ndege.

ko.L: 그들이 새처럼 저를 사냥하고 또 사냥하였습니다, \q 까닭 없이 제 원수가 된 자들이.
ko.B: 까닭 없이 제 원수가 된 사람들이 \q 새를 잡듯이 저를 사냥했습니다.
ko.R: 제 원수들은 저를 미워할 까닭이 없었습니다. \q 그런데도 새를 잡듯이 저를 쫓았습니다.

decisions.choice: eighteenth letter: tsade (verses 52-54)
decisions.reason: Verses 52-54 each begin with tsade, the eighteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: hunted me down: the doubled verb stresses the chase
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated for emphasis: they hunted him without letting up.

decisions.choice: enemies without cause: as in the psalms of the innocent sufferer
decisions.reason: 'Without cause' (chinnam) most likely goes with 'my enemies': those who hate him for no reason, as in Psalm 35:7, 19 and 69:5. It could go with the hunting.

decisions.choice: like a bird: taken with nets and snares
decisions.reason: Birds were caught with nets and traps (Psalm 124:7; Proverbs 6:5).

records.literal_gloss: They have put an end in the pit [to] my life and cast a stone on me.

en.L: They have put an end to my life in the pit \q and cast a stone on me.
en.B: They thrust me into the pit to end my life \q and cast a stone over me.
en.R: They threw me into a pit to kill me \q and put a stone over it.

pt.L: Acabaram com a minha vida na cova \q e lançaram uma pedra sobre mim.
pt.B: Eles me jogaram na cova para acabar com a minha vida \q e puseram uma pedra sobre mim.
pt.R: Eles me jogaram num poço para me matar \q e puseram uma pedra em cima.

fr.L: Ils ont anéanti ma vie dans la fosse \q et ils ont jeté une pierre sur moi.
fr.B: Ils m’ont jeté dans la fosse pour en finir avec ma vie \q et ont posé une pierre sur moi.
fr.R: Ils m’ont jeté dans une fosse pour me tuer \q et ont mis une pierre par-dessus.

es.L: Han acabado con mi vida en la fosa \q y han echado una piedra sobre mí.
es.B: Me arrojaron a la fosa para acabar con mi vida \q y pusieron una piedra encima de mí.
es.R: Me tiraron a un pozo para matarme \q y pusieron una piedra encima.

vi.L: Chúng đã kết liễu mạng sống tôi trong hầm hố \q và đặt một hòn đá trên tôi.
vi.B: Chúng xô tôi xuống hầm để kết liễu đời tôi \q và đặt tảng đá chặn trên tôi.
vi.R: Chúng ném tôi xuống hố để giết tôi \q và đặt một tảng đá trên miệng hố.

sw.L: Wamekomesha uhai wangu shimoni \q na kunitupia jiwe.
sw.B: Walinitupa shimoni ili kukomesha uhai wangu \q na kuweka jiwe juu yangu.
sw.R: Walinitupa ndani ya shimo ili kuniua \q na kuweka jiwe juu yake.

ko.L: 그들이 구덩이 속에서 제 목숨을 끝장내고 \q 제 위에 돌을 던졌습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 제 목숨을 끊으려고 저를 구덩이에 처넣고 \q 그 위에 돌을 덮었습니다.
ko.R: 그들이 저를 죽이려고 구덩이에 던져 넣고 \q 그 위를 돌로 막았습니다.

decisions.choice: put an end to: silence, destroy
decisions.reason: The verb (tsamat) means to bring to an end or silence. They meant the pit to be the end of him; verse 58 says the LORD rescued his life.

decisions.choice: the pit: a cistern, and a picture of the grave
decisions.reason: A pit (bor) was a dug cistern for storing water, sometimes used as a prison (Genesis 37:24). It is also a picture of the grave and the world of the dead (Psalm 28:1; 88:5).

decisions.choice: the pit: Jeremiah in the cistern
decisions.reason: Jeremiah was let down into a muddy cistern to die (Jeremiah 38:6); his story may lie behind verses 53-55.

decisions.choice: a stone: probably one stone over the mouth of the pit
decisions.reason: The word is singular. They may have closed the pit with a stone (compare Daniel 6:18), or thrown stones down at him.

decisions.choice: thrust me into the pit to end my life
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the pit first and say what it was for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Have flowed waters over my head; I said, I am cut off.

en.L: Waters flowed over my head; \q I said, "I am cut off."
en.B: The waters rose over my head, \q and I said, "I am cut off!"
en.R: Water covered my head, \q and I thought, "This is the end of me!"

pt.L: Águas correram sobre a minha cabeça; \q eu disse: "Fui cortado."
pt.B: As águas subiram acima da minha cabeça, \q e eu disse: "Estou acabado!"
pt.R: A água cobriu a minha cabeça, \q e eu pensei: "É o meu fim!"

fr.L: Les eaux ont coulé par-dessus ma tête ; \q j’ai dit : « Je suis retranché. »
fr.B: Les eaux sont montées par-dessus ma tête, \q et j’ai dit : « Je suis retranché ! »
fr.R: L’eau a recouvert ma tête, \q et j’ai pensé : « C’en est fini de moi ! »

es.L: Fluyeron aguas sobre mi cabeza; \q dije: «He sido cortado».
es.B: Las aguas me cubrieron la cabeza, \q y dije: «¡Estoy perdido!».
es.R: El agua me cubrió la cabeza, \q y pensé: «¡Este es mi fin!».

vi.L: Nước tràn qua đầu tôi; \q tôi nói: "Tôi bị dứt bỏ rồi."
vi.B: Nước dâng ngập đầu tôi, \q và tôi nói: "Tôi bị cắt đứt rồi!"
vi.R: Nước ngập đầu tôi, \q và tôi nghĩ: "Thế là hết đời tôi!"

sw.L: Maji yalifurika juu ya kichwa changu; \q nikasema, "Nimekatiliwa mbali."
sw.B: Maji yalipanda juu ya kichwa changu, \q nami nikasema, "Nimekatiliwa mbali!"
sw.R: Maji yalifunika kichwa changu, \q nami nikafikiri, "Huu ndio mwisho wangu!"

ko.L: 물이 제 머리 위로 넘쳤습니다. \q 저는 "나는 끊어졌다" 하고 말했습니다.
ko.B: 물이 제 머리 위까지 차올라 \q 저는 "이제 나는 끊어졌다!" 하고 말했습니다.
ko.R: 물이 제 머리까지 덮쳐서 \q 저는 "이제 나는 끝장이다!" 하고 생각했습니다.

decisions.choice: waters over my head: being overwhelmed, close to death
decisions.reason: Deep water that covers the head is a picture of mortal danger and of the world of the dead (Psalm 69:2-3; 88:8; Jonah 2:6).

decisions.choice: I am cut off: from life and from God
decisions.reason: To be cut off (nigzar) is to be cut away from the land of the living and from God's care (Psalm 88:6; Isaiah 53:8).

decisions.choice: I thought, "This is the end of me!"
decisions.reason: Readable says what being cut off means here, and that he said it to himself.

records.literal_gloss: I called your name, Yahweh, from [the] pit of [the] lowest depths.
